name: Umbra House — Room 9
hours: The housemaster's study at the end of the second-floor corridor; locked with its own key.
sight: A narrow study under the eaves, grey with nine years of dust. Bookshelves bow under site reports and bound rubbings; a field desk stands by the window with an oil lamp, a cold pipe and a mug with a dried ring in it. Maps of the island cover one wall, stuck with pins and thread. A camp bed is made up. A child's drawing of a man with a shovel is pinned at eye level over the desk.
things: Read the pinned map: thread from campus to the ruins field to a point inside the mountain
Take down the rubbings — squares within squares, figures made of little tiles
Look at the child's drawing and the name in the corner
Check the camp bed, the wardrobe, the floor
Find what the shelves are hiding
Sit where he sat and look out of his window at the mountain
secret: Aleksander Hale's study. THE TWELVE TORN PAGES of his field journal (canon) are here: rolled inside the hollow brass base of the oil lamp. Viktor has searched this room twice and missed them; Rowan, Viktor's trust, or a hint from Ashdown ('he never trusted drawers; he trusted things he could carry out of a fire') finds them — not before Day 45 by default. Content, for the GM: (1) the Gate opens to a first print pressed into the central recess; (2) the tiles are records, and 'to take one out is to offer yourself in exchange'; (3) the Tessellate rule, copied from the antechamber wall: what comes from outside cannot be fought, only bound by a contest it accepts, and it is bound by the outcome; (4) his plan to remove one tile for study; (5) a last line: 'If I am wrong, play for me.' The child's drawing is signed VIKTOR, age 12. The wardrobe holds a housemaster's black jacket with a smoke-grey collar. The pinned map is the first reliable route to the Ruin Gate.
access: Inside the sealed house; own lock (the key hangs on silas's ring with the rest; the door can also be lifted off its old hinges).
